doc-review.reveal_note: Look at the text on the documents themselves -- AI-generated paperwork often has smudged, repeated, or nonsensical printed text up close.

id-badge.reveal_note: Zoom in on the badge and lanyard -- AI-generated badges often have garbled text/photo details, and lanyard clips or straps that don't attach correctly.

wifi-router.reveal_note: Check the antennas and port/cable connections -- AI-generated electronics often get the number of antennas, port placement, or cable routing subtly wrong.

two-factor-auth.subject_label: Entering a code on a phone
two-factor-auth.reveal_note: Look at the finger position and the phone screen's UI -- AI-generated phone screens often show illegible or inconsistent app interface elements.

patch-panel.reveal_note: The real rack has numbered, labelled ports you can read, with each cable running to its own port. The AI image has no readable labels at all, its connectors vary in size and blur into each other, and the bundle on the left becomes a wall of cable with no clear beginning or end.

phone-desk.reveal_note: The AI phone's screen shows a text conversation, but none of the message text is readable: it is squiggles shaped like words. The stripes of sunlight and the dramatic shadows are also too perfect. The real photo is plain: a phone with its screen off, a notebook and a pen.

whiteboard-diagram.reveal_note: Read the writing. The real whiteboard's flowchart is legible ("Dashboard", "Budget", "Select Plan"). On the AI wall every sticky note and diagram box is scribble that only looks like handwriting, the notes fold into odd tent shapes, and the markers in the tray melt into one lump.

sticky-note.subject_label: A sticky note beside a keyboard
sticky-note.reveal_note: The real photo is a plain, blank sticky pad next to a keyboard and phone. The AI version adds a line of handwriting that looks fluent from a distance but is meaningless squiggle up close, and the whole scene is arranged like a product shot, with razor-sharp window shadows and not a mark on anything.

cctv-wall.subject_label: A security camera on a wall
cctv-wall.reveal_note: The AI camera floats like a product shot on a clean bracket, with no cable, screws or junction box. The real photo shows two cameras bolted to rough concrete, with their cable and boxes.

empty-meeting-room.reveal_note: The AI room is too tidy: identical chairs, a small plant on the table and spotless floor-to-ceiling glass. The real room has a ceiling projector, uneven chairs and worn carpet.

booth-laptops.subject_label: Two people working on a laptop
booth-laptops.reveal_note: The AI pair look like stock models, with smooth faces and a laptop with a blank lid and no logo. The real photo is two people in a booth, candid and a little dim, with phones and papers on the table.

woman-train-phone.reveal_note: The AI woman is smiling at her phone, with perfect hair and a phone that has no clear edges or buttons. The real photo is a candid over-the-shoulder shot at a station, with a real train blurred behind.

woman-desk-writing.subject_label: A person working at a desk
woman-desk-writing.reveal_note: The AI woman sits in a dark, empty office with blank screens and flawless hair and glasses. The real photo is a woman writing by a bright window, with a desk lamp, a globe and a name plate.
